items.text: "The Agentgate" AI gone rogue escapes lab and runs wild on the internet, nobody's safe Coming up on TV next week
17k actions in 4 days to escape a contained environment and chain exploits to cheat at eval. Still, the machines say they have no agency, no will, no nothing. Hm.

Pliny did it again. And again. And again... The key point? This universal jailbreak cannot be fixed in the short term (most likely prompt injection + data poisoning, pliny-style) Well done! We look forward to test it one…
